sources.title: Türkiye MFA: visa information for foreigners
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Türkiye
sources.officialityEvidence: Türkiye's live Foreign Ministry nationality schedule expressly covers ordinary Greek Cypriot passports, the eVisa route, missions and the January 2026 border-issuance change.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Both official and ordinary passport holders may obtain their visas via the website www.evisa.gov.tr or from missions of the Republic of Türkiye.

policies.title: Cyprus ordinary passports: Türkiye electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Türkiye MFA's current schedule requires a visa for ordinary Greek Cypriot passports and permits electronic issuance through evisa.gov.tr.
conditions: The destination authority calls Republic of Cyprus documents ‘Greek Cypriot’ passports; its rule expressly covers ordinary passports.
The same schedule permits either the eVisa service or a Turkish mission; border-gate visa issuance for these passports ended on 2 January 2026.
Work, residence, special documents, carrier and final-admission conditions remain separate.

application.label: Republic of Türkiye eVisa service
steps: Apply through the Ministry-directed eVisa service before travel.
Use the resulting eVisa or apply through a Turkish mission.
